title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
叶辰揉了揉发痛的屁股，从大坑中爬起来，拍了拍身上的灰尘。不耐烦地说道：“哪来这么多废话，叫你们掌门出来！”“大胆！竟敢对我们天玄宗不敬！”焦候庚顿时怒火中烧，拔剑相向。“一群蝼蚁，也敢在本公子面前放肆！”叶辰冷笑一声，正欲出手教训这些不知天高地厚的家伙，却突然发现自己体内空空如也，一丝法力都调动不了。“怎么回事？我的法力呢？”该死，修为被封了！芭比q了！叶辰脸色大变，破口大骂：“死老头，封我修为，你是想没人给你送终吗？”“师兄，这家伙好像是个普通人，我们直接把他拿下！”一个弟子见叶辰神色慌张，以为他只是个普通人，便壮着胆子说道。“上！”焦候庚一声令下，几个弟子对视一眼，同时出手，挥舞着手中的长剑，向叶辰攻去。叶辰见状，也不着急，虽然修为被封，那曾经在仙界也是炼虚境，凭肉身也能将筑基修士打爆。“砰，砰，砰。”叶辰一拳一个小朋友，几下便将几个炼气期的弟子打翻在地，鼻血横流。“一群废物。”焦候庚见几个炼气期弟子连个凡人都拿不下，大骂一声。“本来不想杀你的，现在我改变主意了。”焦候庚阴冷地看着叶辰。叶辰手上抱于胸前，将头四十五度微微扬起，嘴里吹着口哨，就像没听到一样，毫不理会。“你……”焦候庚见叶辰不理会自己，脸色更加阴冷。挥剑冲向叶辰，要将叶辰斩于剑下。叶辰依旧不理会，待到焦候庚近身，叶辰突然抬起他那四十二码的大脚，狠狠印在焦候庚的脸上。焦候庚被这突如其来的一脚踹得倒飞出去，重重地摔在地上，手中的剑也飞了出去。他挣扎着想要爬起来，却发现脸上剧痛无比，脑袋嗡嗡作响。口鼻流血，脸上一个四十二码的脚印清晰可见。“可恶！我要杀了你！”焦候庚怒吼着，再次冲向叶辰。叶辰不屑地笑了笑，侧身一闪，轻松躲过了焦候庚的攻击，然后又是一脚踢在他的腹部。

焦候庚“哇”地吐出一口鲜血，瘫倒在地，再也爬不起来。围观的弟子都震惊不已，整个人都呆住了，一个身上没有丝毫灵力的人，居然将一个筑基期的修士打得晕厥过去。“你敢打伤我们师兄，你死定了。”焦候庚的狗腿子们反应过来，立刻呵斥道，接着便拔剑冲向叶辰。“住手！”就在这时，一声怒喝传来，一道身影如闪电般掠过，瞬间出现在叶辰面前，一掌将几个弟子震退。“师父！”“掌门！”众人定睛一看，来人正是天玄宗掌门，化神境高手，玄机真人。玄机真人面色阴沉，目光如电般扫过被震退的几名弟子，最后落在叶辰身上。语气不怒自威：“阁下擅闯我天玄宗山门，毁我山门，打伤我宗门弟子，不知有何解释？”叶辰此时也冷静下来，知道今日之事怕是难以善了。他拱了拱手，尽量语气平和地说道：“在下叶辰，并非有意冒犯，只是无意间闯入的。”“阁下好大的胆子，毁我山门，一句无意间闯入就想算了？”玄机真人怒须倒竖，声如洪钟。“就是，小子，你知道这天玄宗的大门多贵吗？”一个弟子指着叶辰的鼻子骂道。叶辰翻了个白眼，这帮土包子，知道什么叫贵？“说吧，要怎么赔？”叶辰不耐烦地掏了掏耳朵。心里却在暗自着急，身上哪里有灵石赔偿，被踹下界时，身上的法宝、灵石都被那老头搜刮干净了。修为又被封住了，对付几个筑基境还行，可在这个化神境面前连逃跑都没机会，只能拖延一下时间了。“掌门，我看这小子分明就是来捣乱的，不如把他抓起来，废了他的修为，让他给咱们当杂役抵债！”一个弟子提议道。“我看行！”其他弟子纷纷附和。“住口！”一声轻喝，一道白影飘然而至，落在叶辰身前。来人也是一位化神境的老者，仙风道骨，鹤发童颜，正是天玄宗太上长老，苏太虚。苏太虚一出现，叶辰便感应到他身上隐隐有法则之力波动，周身还隐隐有仙气环绕。‘不简单，这是一个隐藏大佬，不是表面那么简单’叶辰喃喃自语道。
content_en:
Ye Chen rubbed his sore butt, got up from the pit, and dusted himself off.He said impatiently: "How come there is so much nonsense to ask your leader to come out!" "How dare you! How dare you disrespect our Tianxuan Sect!" Jiao Hougeng suddenly became angry and drew his sword towards each other."How dare a group of ants act presumptuously in front of me!" Ye Chen sneered, and was about to teach these ignorant guys a lesson, but suddenly found that there was nothing in his body, and he could not mobilize any magic power."What's going on? Where's my mana?" Damn it, my cultivation has been blocked!Barbie is qing!Ye Chen's face changed drastically and he cursed loudly: "Damn old man, seal my cultivation, do you want no one to die for you?" "Brother, this guy seems to be an ordinary person, let's just take him down!" Seeing Ye Chen's panic, a disciple thought he was just an ordinary person, so he boldly said."Go!" Jiao Hougeng gave the order. Several disciples looked at each other and took action at the same time, waving the long sword in their hands and attacking Ye Chen.Seeing this, Ye Chen was not in a hurry. Although his cultivation level was sealed, he was once in the Void Refining Realm in the Immortal Realm, and he could defeat the foundation-building monks with his physical body."Bang, bang, bang." Ye Chen punched a child and knocked several Qi-refining-stage disciples to the ground with a few punches, causing nosebleeds."A bunch of trash." Jiao Hougeng cursed when he saw that several disciples in the Qi Refining Stage couldn't even take down a mortal."I didn't want to kill you originally, but now I have changed my mind." Jiao Hougeng looked at Ye Chen coldly.Ye Chen held his hands in front of his chest, raised his head slightly at 45 degrees, and whistled in his mouth, as if he didn't hear it and ignored it."You..." Jiao Hougeng's face became even colder when he saw that Ye Chen was ignoring him.He swung his sword and rushed towards Ye Chen, intending to kill Ye Chen with his sword.Ye Chen still ignored him, but when Jiao Hougeng got closer, Ye Chen suddenly raised his forty-two-sized foot and stamped it hard on Jiao Hougeng's face.Jiao Hougeng was kicked backwards by this sudden kick, fell heavily to the ground, and the sword in his hand also flew out.He struggled to get up, but found that his face was in severe pain and his head was buzzing.His mouth and nose were bleeding, and a size 42 footprint was clearly visible on his face."Damn it! I'm going to kill you!" Jiao Hougeng roared and rushed towards Ye Chen again.Ye Chen smiled disdainfully, dodged sideways, easily dodged Jiao Hougeng's attack, and then kicked him in the abdomen.

Jiao Hougeng spat out a mouthful of blood, collapsed to the ground, and could no longer get up.The disciples who were watching were shocked and stunned. A man without any spiritual power in his body actually beat a monk in the foundation building stage until he fainted."You dare to hurt our senior brother, you are dead." Jiao Hougeng's henchmen reacted and immediately scolded, then drew their swords and rushed towards Ye Chen."Stop!" At this moment, an angry shout came, and a figure passed by like lightning, appearing in front of Ye Chen in an instant, knocking away several disciples with a palm."Master!" "Master!" Everyone took a closer look and saw that the person coming was none other than the leader of Tianxuan Sect, a master in the realm of gods and the master of Xuanji.Master Xuanji's face was gloomy, his eyes swept across the several disciples who were knocked back like lightning, and finally fell on Ye Chen.His tone was calm and authoritative: "Your Majesty broke into our Tianxuan Sect's gate without authorization, destroyed my gate, and injured my disciples. I don't know what explanation you have for that?" Ye Chen also calmed down at this time, knowing that what happened today is probably going to be difficult.He cupped his hands and said as calmly as possible: "My dear, Ye Chen, I didn't mean to offend, I just broke in unintentionally." "How dare you, your Excellency, to destroy my mountain gate and just want to forget it with just one sentence of unintentional intrusion?" Master Xuanji's beard stood upright in anger, and his voice was like a bell."That's right, kid, do you know how expensive the gate of Xuanzong is today?" A disciple pointed at Ye Chen's nose and cursed.Ye Chen rolled his eyes, these bumpkins, do they know what expensive is?"Tell me, how do you want to compensate?" Ye Chen picked his ears impatiently.But he was secretly worried about where he could find any spiritual stones to compensate him. When he was kicked down to the lower realm, all the magic weapons and spiritual stones on his body were taken away by the old man.The cultivation level has been sealed again, and it is okay to deal with a few Foundation Establishment Realms, but in front of this Divine Transformation Realm, there is no chance to escape, so we can only delay for a while."Master, I think this kid is obviously here to cause trouble. Why don't we arrest him, destroy his cultivation, and let him work as a handyman to pay off our debts!" ​​A disciple suggested."I think it works!" Other disciples agreed."Shut up!" With a soft shout, a white shadow floated over and landed in front of Ye Chen.The person who came was also an old man in the realm of gods, with an immortal demeanor and a childish face. He was none other than the Supreme Elder of Tianxuan Sect, Su Taixu.As soon as Su Taixu appeared, Ye Chen sensed the faint fluctuations of law power in his body, and there was also a faint fairy energy surrounding him.'It's not simple, this is a hidden boss, it's not as simple as it appears,' Ye Chen murmured to himself.
